review: Qt takeCentralWidget transfers the one original PlayerWorkspace into the retained shared ToolPage. MainWindow keeps an explicit stable workspace field for its existing16 routes; ordinary show after transfer returns the shared host, diagnostic layout remains attached to its main window. Operator/chat shortcuts select the group without resetting its child; actual form instances and drafts remain. Original back shortcut is parented to the movable workspace. A header action invokes the original workspace history; host history retains cross-reader reading. Only chat uses ignored vertical size hints so hidden pages do not force its minimum height; other pages retain scrolling. Existing pinned superqt QCollapsible hides connection controls; original backend callbacks, credentials and protocol fields are reused, relevant rows follow the mode. Expanded height is recomputed after mode changes; default collapsed content is explicitly set to zero. No new retries, catches, side-effect validation or private persistence.
